description: This file defines a Lua module named 'luax' that provides a JSX-like string builder for HTML/XML generation. It includes utility functions for manipulating strings, tables, and attributes, and exposes a main function 'luax' for constructing markup with support for self-closing tags, nested elements, and attributes.

methods.name: utils.is_single_closing
methods.description: Determines if an element is a self-closing tag based on a predefined list.

methods.name: utils.join
methods.description: Joins an array of strings into a single string with an optional separator.

methods.name: utils.map
methods.description: Maps data elements to strings or components using a callback.

methods.name: utils.match
methods.description: Performs a case match for inline logic based on a key.

methods.name: utils.split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a separator.

methods.name: utils.filter
methods.description: Filters a list based on a callback predicate.

methods.name: utils.merge
methods.description: Merges two tables into a new table (similar to object spread).

methods.name: utils.insert
methods.description: Inserts a string segment into a main string at a specified position.

methods.name: utils.format_props
methods.description: Formats a table of properties into a string suitable for HTML attributes.

methods.name: utils.children_to_string
methods.description: Converts children elements (strings, tables) into a single string.

methods.name: luax
methods.description: Main function that constructs HTML/XML strings based on tag, properties, and children. Handles self-closing tags and nested elements.
